notes: Choosing a weather icon set now actually changes the icons. Nothing told a panel that the weather settings had changed, so a new set sat unused until the panel next refreshed on its own — up to ten minutes, or until it was reopened.…

A second fault underneath it: the list of valid icon sets was written out a second time in the background, and still named only the original three. Choosing the fourth was quietly rewritten back to the first. There is now one list, held by…

The sets are genuinely different now. Two of the three were previously the same drawings in outline and filled form, which is one set shown twice rather than a choice. They are now three separate icon families — Line, Rounded and Solid…

The fog emoji has been changed. The old one renders as a featureless pale smudge at panel size with nothing in it to recognise. Emoji coverage for fog is poor in general; all three drawn sets have a proper fog icon.
